text: Clean the place where you will do the puja, draw a muggu, and decorate it with flowers.
Spread a clean cloth on a puja peeta and place the picture or idol of Sri Mahalakshmi Ammavaru on it.
Place a turmeric Ganapati or a Ganapati idol beside it.
Keep the puja items, the naivedyam and the harathi plate ready.
Also get 5, 7, 9 or 11 clay lamps ready, to light once the puja is done.
